name: healthchat-ai
description: AI-powered health assistant - full stack application

scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && venv\Scripts\activate && python main.py runserver
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.setup: cd frontend && npm install && echo. && echo Setup complete! Run 'npm start' to launch the app.
